distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Guizhou, including Pingtang. Lin & Smith (2022) adds Taiwan as Present. Smith et al. (2022) reports Guizhou and Yunnan and adds Honghe locality evidence. The reviewed distribution is the union Guizhou + Yunnan + Taiwan.

host_note: Carya sp. is retained from Smith et al. (2020), and Machilus zuihoensis from Lin & Smith (2022). Smith et al. (2022) provides no host in the curated record, so the current host synthesis is unchanged.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Coptodryas mus (Eggers, 1930).
